## Technical reference

- [Take section bounds from the loader, not from 0xFF runs](../reference/hazard.ff-is-not-free.md): An 0xFF run in the file can lie outside the section load, so code placed there is never loaded.
- [Align structures with 32-bit fields to four bytes](../reference/hazard.word-alignment.md): Misaligned word access restarted a PEN-F that the emulator had accepted.
- [COLOR builder call site](../reference/pen-f-3101.color-builder-call.md): The HSL extension applies hue and lightness after this call and rejoins at 0x604f750b.
- [COLOR table](../reference/pen-f-3101.color-table.md): 3,028 bytes: 12 records of 28 bytes, four u32 LUTs, six u16 LUTs and a trailer.
- [Main CPU base](../reference/pen-f-3101.main-base.md): Decoded main offset 0 runs at 0x60021020.
- [Main container address](../reference/pen-f-3101.main-container.md): Container payload address of the main component; not a disassembler base.
- [Queued section loader](../reference/pen-f-3101.queued-loader.md): Native load callback that copies a section through the flash wrapper.
- [Section 3 descriptor](../reference/pen-f-3101.section-3-descriptor.md): Descriptor for section 3, which holds the COLOR builder and coefficient tables.
- [Section 3 free tail](../reference/pen-f-3101.section-3-tail.md): Unused 0xFF bytes inside the end of section 3's load.
- [Section load request](../reference/pen-f-3101.section-load-request.md): Requests a section load; USTART1 calls it for section 3, which then crosses to CPU1.
- [Start a task](../reference/pen-f-3101.task-start.md): Ordinary task-start wrapper over the local kernel start API 0x600307dd.
